intended_object: The canonical bijection between finitely supported functions Option α →₀ M and pairs (value at none, restriction to some) in M × (α →₀ M), i.e. M^{(1 ⊔ α)} ≅ M × M^{(α)}. Inferred from the docstring and name.
explanation: The forward map sends P to (P none, P.some), where `Finsupp.some` restricts P to the `some` part. The inverse embeds the second component along `Option.some` and sets the value at `none` to the first component. These are the expected maps, and the proofs show they are mutually inverse. The only assumption is `[Zero M]`, which is the least a `Finsupp` needs, so the generality is the natural one. A search of Mathlib found no other equivalence of this shape.
